rules.style: Painted HOI4/EaW objects, readable at 64x64, transparent exterior, one dominant assembly and at most two supporting motifs from the unchanged brief.
precedence: Canonical context and explicit brief colors/exclusions
Per-record contextual material clarifications in this file
Category swatches as optional balance, never a mandatory whole-icon tint
rules.material_policy: Retain natural materials and sparse highlights. Category mappings and inherited material palettes are copied from palette-guidance; contextual clarifications prevent keyword false matches. Do not add props merely because a material rule mentions them. Explicit brass objects override a generic steel assignment.
rules.heraldry: None of these 49 briefs requires a flag or crown. No new heraldry, logos, party insignia, aircraft roundels, external franchise symbols, humans/hands, pseudo-text or invented anatomy. Swatches are not national colors.
rules.polarity: Effect character is a semantic interpretation, not ideological endorsement or an automatic reading of numeric signs. Reduced costs/training time can be beneficial. Preserve mixed effects through object state and arrangement; never red=bad/green=good or universal gold/cobalt.
rules.evidence: Effects and canonical context are copied from the native briefs; original sprite imagery is not authority for added symbols. Numeric effects are context, not text to render on the icon.
rules.approval: This file grants no art approval. Source and 64x64 export visual review, hashes and binding checks remain separate.

records.name: Erie-Eyrie Rivalry
records.source_brief: Two duelling swords locked across a cracked boundary stone, one grip ivory and the other cobalt.
records.effect_evidence: tag=EYR; attack_bonus_against=0.05; defense_bonus_against=0.1; tag=ERI; attack_bonus_against=0.05; defense_bonus_against=0.1; war_support_factor=-0.025
records.description:
§RTwo households, both alike in dignity,
From ancient grudge break to new mutiny,
Where civil blood makes civil claws unclean.§!
§W--------------§!
The bitter feud between the rival houses of Eyrie and Erie - both houses as irreconcilable to each other as the Sun and Moon, Day and Night - has led to decades of incessant internecine violence between the two heavily militarised houses. Both leaders of the houses claim to be the rightful and legitimate Dukes of Verenia, and both of them refuse to negotiate with each other. The violence will likely continue until one side proves triumphant.
records.canonical_context: Shared Erie/Eyrie spirit, not an Avian-owned rivalry. Colour accents are material cues, not invented heraldry. The localized refusal to negotiate describes the native feud, not all later submod routes.

records.name: Tripartite Common Market Agreement
records.source_brief: A three-stall market enclosed by one outer tariff rail, its internal toll chains laid aside.
records.description: The ratification of the Tripartite Common Market Agreement by the Three Houses has officially allowed for the close integration of their national economies, boosting economic growth by enforcing protectionist policies against foreign nations whilst greatly liberalising trade between the Three Houses. Although there arises from time to time occasional skirmishes or border wars between Houses Erie and Eyrie, the neutral House Avian acts as an arbitrator and so prevents the agreement from falling apart - an advantageous, if somewhat convoluted, state of affairs that all three Houses, despite their differences, are happy to maintain.
records.canonical_context: Preserve the native description's economic integration and Avian arbitration; no annexation, unified flag or claim that all rivalry has ended.
